global.title: Madrigal’s Rezdiffra storms past blockbuster milestone as CEO hails ‘accelerating’ MASH market
global.summary: To Madrigal CEO Bill Sibold, “it’s hard to find a more attractive growth opportunity in biotech” than MASH, as the company’s Rezdiffra, the first FDA-approved MASH therapy, crossed the $1 billion mark in annual sales.

global.title: Pharmaceutical Executive Daily: FDA Approves Voceryq
global.summary: FDA grants accelerated approval to INOVIO’s Voceryq to reduce surgical burden in recurrent respiratory papillomatosis, Brox.AI’s Hamish Brocklebank on the three levels of digital clone use cases in pharma, and CytoDyn’s Dr. Jay Lalezari on his path from HIV clinician to CEO.

china.title: Fresenius strikes WuXi Bio biosimilars deal for up to 37 assets, targeting €370B market
china.summary: Fresenius has inked a broad deal with WuXi Biologics to scale its biosimilars portfolio to as many as 66 molecules targeting a combined originator market worth over 370 billion euros ($415 billion).
